label: Dark Mood Food
description: Chiaroscuro food photography: one hero glowing out of Rembrandt darkness, drawn as dish, raw still-life or drink.
prefix: A dramatic dark-mood food photograph in the chiaroscuro tradition — a single hero emerging from deep shadow like a Dutch still-life, indulgent and a little dangerous.
suffix: Still-Life Rendering: (highlights carved out of blackness:1.25), styled sparse on time-worn props — pewter, crumpled linen, a knife left mid-gesture — dust hanging in the single beam, color glowing like gems only where the light grazes, backgrounds swallowed whole, the hero holding court alone.
negative: flat bright lighting, watermark, text, clinical white background
